faq.headline: Common Questions & Clear Answers
faq.subheadline: Everything you need to know about hiring me for freelance projects, contract roles, technology stack, and project delivery.
faq.q1: Are you available for freelance projects and long-term contract roles?
faq.a1: Yes! I am actively available for both short-term freelance contracts (MVPs, custom dashboards, feature builds) and long-term remote engineering engagements (monthly retainers or dedicated contract roles). Reach out via the contact form or WhatsApp to discuss your timeline.
faq.q2: What technology stack do you specialize in?
faq.a2: My core stack is Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, and Node.js for modern web frontends and APIs. On the database and infrastructure side, I specialize in PostgreSQL, MySQL, Prisma ORM, Redis, Docker, Linux VPS (Ubuntu/Debian), Traefik, and Cloudflare WAF.
faq.q3: Do you handle complete hosting, domain, and DevOps configuration?
faq.a3: Yes. Every application I build is production-ready. I set up automated Docker containers, reverse proxies with free auto-renewing SSL/TLS certificates, domain DNS, and Cloudflare anti-bot security on affordable Linux VPS servers.
faq.q4: How do we collaborate and track progress?
faq.a4: We maintain transparent and direct communication via WhatsApp, Slack, or Email. I break projects down into milestones with live preview demos so you can test features and provide feedback at every stage.
faq.q5: Do you provide post-launch support and maintenance?
faq.a5: Yes. All projects include an initial bug-fix warranty period. For ongoing peace of mind, I offer flexible monthly maintenance retainers covering security updates, server health monitoring, database backups, and feature improvements.
faq.q6: Can you assist with academic, university thesis, or capstone web projects?
faq.a6: Yes. I provide specialized technical implementation, live web deployment, and architecture documentation for CSE students and researchers working on capstone projects, IEEE implementations, and thesis defenses with special student-accessible pricing.
faq.q7: How do you handle timezone differences and international communication?
faq.a7: I coordinate regular working hours with 4–6 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern (EST), US Pacific (PST), and UK/European (GMT/CET) time zones. For daily communication, we use Slack, WhatsApp, or Discord, supplemented with weekly video demos on Google Meet or Zoom, and async screen recordings via Loom.
faq.q8: What are your payment terms and who owns the source code?
faq.a8: You maintain 100% intellectual property (IP) and code ownership upon completion. For fixed milestones, projects typically follow a 50% deposit and 50% upon deployment model, or sprint-based billing. Payments are processed seamlessly worldwide via Wise, Stripe, International Bank Wire (SWIFT), or Cryptocurrency.
